title: Warm Greek Lamb Skewers
description: A sweet and savory Greek dish featuring lamb skewers, perfect for a brunch mood, made with brandy and low-glycemic-friendly ingredients, cooked on a comal.
instructions: Preheat the comal over medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together brandy, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush the comal with a small amount of olive oil to prevent sticking.
Place the lamb skewers on the comal and cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
After flipping the skewers, deglaze the comal with a small amount of brandy, scraping up any browned bits.
Remove the skewers from the comal and let rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the warm lamb skewers hot, garnished with fresh oregano and lemon wedges if desired.
